findings.issue: (Carried over from round 1, unchanged because src/engine/invariants.ts and src/playtest/cli.ts were not modified.) The raise half of L4 (`amount !== before.currentBet + unit`) can never fire after L3 passes. legalActions computes raiseTo with the same formula (`hand.ts:226`), so any raise in the legal set already matches. No test covers it, and the mutant that removes it survives. Only the bet half is exercised, through the artificial `currentBet: -1` before-state, which pushes legalActions into its bet branch. That test is valid but checks a state the engine can't produce.
findings.evidence: Mutation L4raise SURVIVED. Coverage reports the line-84 branch as partly uncovered. legalActions: `const raiseTo = state.currentBet + unit`.
findings.fix: Keep it as the A-4 guard, but add a comment saying it only guards against a future legalActions change. Alternatively, test it through a step whose `before.stakes` differs from the stakes legalActions used, which isn't possible. If neither is acceptable, record it as accepted untested defensive code.

findings.issue: (Carried over from round 1, unchanged because src/engine/invariants.ts and src/playtest/cli.ts were not modified.) A wrong hole-card count is reported with the board/burn template, e.g. `flop has 3 board and 1 burn cards`. Those numbers are correct for the flop, so the message hides the real fault (a seat holding 1 or 3 cards). The spec's single K2 template forces this.
findings.evidence: cardsMessage folds `players.some(p => p.holeCards.length !== 2)` into the same `if` as the board/burn length check and returns the street template.
findings.fix: Propose a spec amendment (the D-2 template was user-approved) to add `seat <s> has <n> hole cards`, and return that message from the hole-card clause. Until then, leave it.

findings.issue: (Carried over from round 1, unchanged because src/engine/invariants.ts and src/playtest/cli.ts were not modified.) When award totals match contributions but one award's winner shares don't sum to its amount, and the shares still total the same overall, the message reads `awards pay $20 but players put in $20`, which names no fault.
findings.evidence: `awarded !== total ? awarded : paid`. With paid === total and only `balanced` false, both numbers are equal.
findings.fix: For the per-award case, report the award itself, e.g. `<pot> awards $<amount> but winners get $<shares>`. This needs a template amendment. Otherwise put the pot name in the existing wording.

findings.issue: (Carried over from round 1, unchanged because src/engine/invariants.ts and src/playtest/cli.ts were not modified.) `if (hand === null || hand.violation === null) return ''` guards a state that summarize can't produce: violations > 0 implies a hand with a non-null violation. It is also the only uncovered line range in cli.ts (135-143 branch).
findings.evidence: Coverage: cli.ts uncovered branch 135-143. summarize sets firstViolation whenever any hand.violation !== null.
findings.fix: Keep it only if the type narrowing needs it. Otherwise narrow with a non-null assertion, or pass firstViolation from formatReport's condition (`summary.firstViolation?.violation`).

findings.issue: (Carried over from round 1, unchanged because src/engine/invariants.ts and src/playtest/cli.ts were not modified.) actionText repeats describeAction's wording for the five player action types. The spec allowed delegating (optional), so the two copies can now drift apart.
findings.evidence: cli.ts:156-167 and invariants.ts:38-51 contain the same strings.
findings.fix: Optional: in actionText, handle only the two blind types and delegate the rest to describeAction(toAction(record)).

findings.issue: When the P1 'seat not dealt in' clause is removed, the row fails with a TypeError from P3's `as PlayerState` cast, not with an assertion mismatch. The mutant is still caught, but the failure points at P3 instead of P1.
findings.evidence: Mutant P1 (dropping `playerAt(state, seat) !== undefined &&`) gives 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading totalContribution)'.
findings.fix: No change needed. Optionally add a comment on the row explaining that P1 also guards P3's cast, which keeps checkState from throwing.
